rationale: Describes conventional serverless, event-driven compute that runs code without server provisioning and can be triggered from other services. No AI or ML functionality is described.
evidence_spans: AWS Lambda is a serverless, event-driven compute service that lets you run code for virtually any type of application or backend service without provisioning or managing servers.
You can trigger Lambda from over 200 AWS services and software as a service (SaaS) applications, and only pay for what you use.
